notes.title: Version 2.0.1.a BUG PAtch FIX
notes.notes:
Quick update all.

The latest content update introduced a few bug gameplay bugs that have hopefully been fixed. None of these were game-breaking, but it was just a matter of polish.

Another bug was introduced mostly due to the growing player base.
If your position is around certain players on the leaderboards who have names which cannot be properly decoded it would throw a game breaking bug.

I am hoping this patch has fixed this, it's difficult for me to tell because I would have to have a score that's close to said players... and I have no idea what that score is.

Please comment in this thread if you experience such problems, also if you know your score, that would also be invaluable information in tracking down this bug if it persists. Cheers!

notes.title: New Area and Boss! Gunlock Version 2.0.0.a
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/Wi6mHmS.png

Happy Lunar New Year All!

Gunlock Version 2.0.0.a is out now, and in addition to some bug / balance fixes, the update comes with additional FREE content.

Take up arms on the Skyforge, a brand new level, with brand new enemies, and a brand new Boss, and brand new popping music, by the awesome Brian Havey (zminusone)!

If you're enjoying the game and content updates, please consider leaving a review. In addition to helping support my work, a review also helps others find Gunlock on their Steam page.

Hope you all enjoy the update area! (It's TOUGH!)

Cheers!

EDIT: Version  2.0.0.b has been pushed out, a bug with the way save/load data was managed would crash the game for players with pre-existing data. Hopefully this has been fixed.

notes.title: Gunlock Update 1.0.1.k
notes.notes:
A small update based on some early player feedback.

Version 1.0.1.k

    Minor adjustments to control responsiveness and delay timers that should make it easier to perform more complicated maneuvers.
    Fixed bug that would not allow player to get the 'Painterly II" achievement.
    Nerfed the overpowered gun.


If anyone has any more suggestions that you think would improve the experience / you would just like to see, feel free to leave comments below. I'll try add / adjust anything that is 'reasonable'. Cheers!
